name: conductor
description: Claude Code plugin that splits a goal into tasks and runs them in parallel across Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and Antigravity, each in its own git worktree.

enabled.title: Conductor on
enabled.description: Off: no heartbeat, nothing is planned or dispatched; workers already running finish on their own.

worker_claude.title: Worker: Claude (claude -p)
worker_claude.description: Switches the claude worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review.

worker_codex.title: Worker: Codex (codex exec)
worker_codex.description: Switches the codex worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review.

worker_opencode.title: Worker: OpenCode (opencode run)
worker_opencode.description: Switches the opencode worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review.

worker_cursor.title: Worker: Cursor (agent)
worker_cursor.description: Switches the cursor worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review.

worker_antigravity.title: Worker: Antigravity (agy)
worker_antigravity.description: Switches the antigravity worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review.

worker_openrouter.title: Worker: OpenRouter (text only)
worker_openrouter.description: Switches the openrouter worker for every project. Off, it leaves routing and review. It only writes file content (docs, fixtures) for tasks labelled executor:openrouter.

redact_transcript.title: LGPD redaction in the conversation
redact_transcript.description: Masks CPF, CNPJ and secrets before the conversation stores each message; the model then sees the masked text too.
